status: UNSIGNED-STUB — Peat signs when reviewed. signed_by: null = not yet ratified.
purpose: Records Advanced-tier controls that are explicitly N/A for a solo digital garden. Prevents over-building / enterprise theater. audit-rail-barrier-class.sh consults this file for signed friction-waivers. Peat's signature on each entry is the human gate.

scope_na_controls.reason: Solo garden — no hardware security module / TPM; no shared org identity infrastructure. Platform-default process isolation accepted.
Requires hardware attestation chip. Not available and not justified for a single-operator project.
microVM / Kata-container style execution isolation exceeds the risk profile of a personal website. OS-level process isolation is the appropriate ceiling.

scope_na_controls.control: JIT/JEA with auto-expiry (Just-In-Time / Just-Enough-Access credential issuance)
scope_na_controls.reason: Single operator with no external IdP. Session-scoped permissions in settings.json is the practical equivalent.

scope_na_controls.control: mTLS with certificate pinning (mutual TLS full lifecycle)
scope_na_controls.reason: No inter-service API calls requiring mutual TLS. Claude Code session transport handled by platform. N/A for local agentic tooling.

scope_na_controls.control: OS-level sandboxing (seccomp / AppArmor / network namespace / restricted mounts)
scope_na_controls.reason: Platform-default sandboxing accepted. Adding seccomp profiles to a local dev environment adds complexity without meaningful risk reduction for a solo operator.
Local append-only audit logs (signature files, hook-logs) are the appropriate logging tier. No external SIEM required for a solo garden.

scope_na_controls.control: Formal governance committee / automated compliance checks
scope_na_controls.reason: Single operator. Peat IS the governance committee. Policy is encoded in axioms-v1.json (Peat-signed).
No protected health information. Not applicable.
No financial data or regulated trading activity. Not applicable.
Personal website with no user data collection, no accounts, no analytics storing personal data. GDPR-by-design via no-collection posture.
Not a US federal system. Not applicable.

scope_na_controls.control: ML behavioral anomaly detection (contextual, Enterprise+ tier)
scope_na_controls.reason: Session volume too low for ML baselines to be meaningful. LLM judge (watchdog) in shadow mode is the appropriate residue.

_instructions: To activate a friction-waiver for a mode=block FRICTION-ONLY rail: add an entry to friction_waivers array with {rail_key, reason, signed_by: <Peat's explicit sign-off>, signed_date}. audit-rail-barrier-class.sh reads friction_waivers[]. Peat must set signed_by — agents may not self-sign.
